# v2026.11.7

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.7.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.7.md).

This release covers **4 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Sync now reads every integration by default. Each integration has an "Include in Sync now" switch to leave it out. ([#502](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/502), [#504](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/504))
- Each integration page has its own Sync button. ([#504](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/504))
- Old orders get their remake flag on the next sweep run, so held old remake jobs settle by the Remake rule. ([#507](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/507))

## Changes

- Sync now is on the Integrations page, and reads every integration by default. Turn off "Include in Sync now" to leave one out. ([#502](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/502), [#504](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/504))
- Each integration page has a Sync button. Disconnect moves to the end of the page and asks first. ([#504](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/504))

## Fixes

- The "Include in Sync now" switch works on a phone. ([#504](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/504))
- Old orders get their remake flag on the next sweep run. ([#507](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/507))
